Salami Wraps
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 23, 2009 - 11:31pm

Ingredients




24 slices hard salami
1 lg. pkg. cream cheese
4 dill pickles, cut into 6 strips each

Preparation

1 Spread salami slices with cream cheese. Place a strip of pickle at the edge of the slice and roll up, sealing with the cream cheese. Makes 24.
